# ImobX — Takeoff Auto 3D (imobx.md)

> ImobX builds software for real estate businesses. Takeoff Auto 3D, its first
> B2B product, turns 3D building models into quantities, material lists and
> client-ready cost estimates — automatically. Copyright (c) 2026 ImobX.
> All rights reserved.

Author: ImobX, Republic of Moldova
Contact: contact@imobx.md

## Features

- 3D model import: opens SketchUp models directly and inspects geometry,
  layers and structure — no manual redrawing
- Automatic quantities: roof areas, surfaces and linear measurements computed
  straight from the model — accurately, every time
- Material assemblies: configurable material systems map every measured
  surface to the right products and labor items
- Deviz-ready estimates: structured cost estimates (deviz) in Excel — internal
  SEM sheets and client-facing variants
- Client-ready PDFs: polished, branded quote documents generated from the
  same data
- Scenario pricing: compare material systems and price variants side by side
  to find the right margin for every bid
- Proven: developed and validated against more than 40 real estimating
  projects, end to end
